notes: Uses diff::slice on the lines of each text. diff::lines adds an extra empty-line entry for a trailing newline, which is not a line of either text; slice diffs exactly the lines, like the other adapters.
details: Uses diff::slice on the lines of each text. diff::lines on a text that ends with a newline appends one extra empty-line entry to mark that newline, which is not a line of either text; slice diffs exactly the lines, as the other adapters do.
